segments.text: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
They say unto him,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned:

segments.speaker: Scribes and Pharisees
segments.text: but what sayest thou?
This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

segments.speaker: Woman
segments.text: She said,
No man, Lord.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus said unto her,
Neither do I condemn thee:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: go, and sin no more.
¶ Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
The Pharisees therefore said unto him,

segments.speaker: The Pharisees
segments.text: Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
Jesus answered and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
Then said Jesus again unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
Then said the Jews,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: Then said they unto him,
Who art thou?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And Jesus saith unto them,
Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
Then said Jesus unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
As he spake these words, many believed on him.
Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: ¶ They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
Jesus answered them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: Ye do the deeds of your father.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Then said they to him,
We be not born of fornication;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: we have one Father, even God.
Jesus said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
Then answered the Jews, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus answered,
I have not a devil;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

segments.speaker: Jews
segments.text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
Jesus answered,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
Then said the Jews unto him,

segments.speaker: The Jews
segments.text: Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Jesus said unto them,
Verily, verily, I say unto you,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Before Abraham was, I am.
Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
